audience.en: Aya, a 30-year-old nurse in Osaka with a bachelor's degree, 7 years in acute care and ¥3,500,000 saved, who wants to work as a registered nurse in Australia from 2028 and needs the registration steps, English scores, visa options and budget.
audience.ja: 大阪在住の30歳の看護師アヤさん（学士、急性期での勤務7年、貯蓄¥3,500,000）が、2028年からオーストラリアで正看護師として働くために、登録の手順、英語のスコア、ビザの選択肢、予算を知りたい場合の案内です。

localeReason: Japanese serves this decision directly: the nurse lives in Osaka, her qualification, payslip and savings are in yen and Japanese, and reading the stream, English-score, visa and budget conditions in Japanese helps her compare an agent's or test centre's explanation with the regulator's English wording. It changes no rule, score, fee or date.

planningAssumptions.person: Aya, 30, bachelor's degree in nursing, 7 years in acute care, ¥3,500,000 saved, target: working as an RN in Australia from 2028; she estimates IELTS 6.5.
planningAssumptions.stream: Stream B is an inference from the published criteria; only the Ahpra Self-check assigns the stream. Calendar months in the timeline are planning estimates, not official dates.
planningAssumptions.exchange: A = ¥108.92 and A = US/bin/zsh.6900 (Reserve Bank of Australia, 6 November 2026). Each A$ and ¥ cell is rounded to whole units and totals add the rounded cells.
planningAssumptions.budget: A$10,886 / ¥1,185,810 is officially priced; A$15,889 / ¥1,730,693 (59%) is allowance: test preparation ¥50,000, documents ¥100,000, return flights ¥200,000, accommodation A$160 x 8 nights, food A$70 x 8 days, one-way flight ¥150,000, shipping ¥50,000, rent A$2,000 x 2, bond A$2,000, living costs A$1,500 x 2. The NCLEX base case assumes registering after 1 February 2027 and the US$150 scheduling fee unchanged (assumed).
planningAssumptions.pay: NSW weekly rates from 1 July 2026; hourly = weekly / 38, annual = weekly x 52.17857; Japan figures are the national average for ages 30 to 34 and for all ages, not Aya's salary.

datePolicy: Pages were read on 2026-11-08 in the original run and that access date is kept for every source. Source dates (fee schedules, test-score effective dates, 1 February 2027, 30 June 2027, 1 July 2027) are not access dates. Copy editing and translation are not a refresh.
uncertainties: Stream B is an inference from the published criteria; only the Ahpra Self-check assigns the stream, and completing the stages does not guarantee registration.
The comparable-jurisdiction list read is dated April 2025; no later list was found on 2026-11-08.

Whether a visitor visa 600 or an ETA 601 is the right permission to sit the OSCE is unconfirmed; the A$250 visitor charge was read from the price-list data because the visible table did not load fully.

OET yen fee and OET on Computer availability in Japan, the IELTS fee of ¥27,500 at other centres, the PTE yen price, and TOEFL and Cambridge fees are unconfirmed or not researched; the NCLEX scheduling fee after 1 February 2027 is assumed unchanged.
Whether a second OSCE sitting costs another A$4,000 is unconfirmed.
Which ANMAC assessment applies (Modified A$395 or Full A$595), and whether the 482 needs a skills assessment for the nominated RN code, is unconfirmed.

The 189 70-point total is our own sum; the scores defining Proficient English, current invitation cut-offs and state 190 nurse lists were not read; the further requirements of the 186 were not read; who pays the 482 charge is unknown.
Queensland pay-point dollar figures come from a third-party site; the NSW placement of an overseas-qualified RN is not stated; the 12% super figure was not re-read for 2026-27.
A$15,889 / ¥1,730,693 (59%) of the budget is allowance, not quotes.
The arithmetic recheck of the money figures was a separate pass within the same project, not an outside review.

provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Local files only. The README locale contract and VOICE-GUIDE were read first, then the run's index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md. No network research, build or publication during authoring. The Japanese page was translated from the English guide.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Some Ahpra, NMBA and Home Affairs pages were read through a clean browser because plain requests were blocked; the Queensland Health pay tables were not readable (bot challenge not bypassed); the ATO super page was read through a managed browser profile and not re-read for 2026-27; the Home Affairs visitor-visa price was read from the page's price-list data.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: A separate recomputation of the money arithmetic and claim check found 161 of 161 automated checks passing and listed nine remaining issues (allowances are not facts; which ANMAC assessment applies; visitor visa versus ETA; Queensland pay table unreadable; 189 English definition and cut-offs not read; Stream B is an inference; NSW placement not stated; visitor-visa price read from price-list data; ATO page read through a managed browser profile). The guide keeps all of them. The recheck was a separate pass within the same project, not an outside review. The page names the NMBA, not Ahpra, as the source of the 'unlikely to meet criterion 2' list for Japan.
provenance.editingContract: Only data/japanese-nurse-australia-ahpra-stream-b-nclex-osaka-english-scores-and-budget.json, en/ and ja/ Markdown for this slug and checks/batch44-japanese-nurse-australia-ahpra-stream-b-nclex-osaka-english-scores-and-budget-notes.md were written.
